question: Does starting Video Talk plus granting browser camera permission authorize model-requested one-frame captures for the whole active session, or must each `describe_view` capture require another user confirmation?
rationale: The code can enforce either consent model, but repository evidence does not establish which privacy contract maintainers intend to ship.

options.title: Session-scoped consent
options.body: Treat the explicit Video Talk action, native permission prompt, active preview, and stop control as consent for bounded captures while that session remains active.

options.title: Confirm every capture
options.body: Require a visible user confirmation before each model-requested camera frame is encoded and sent.

options.title: Pause Video Talk
options.body: Defer the feature until the camera-consent contract and live provider proof are agreed.

recommendation.title: Session-scoped consent
recommendation.body: Treat the explicit Video Talk action, native permission prompt, active preview, and stop control as consent for bounded captures while that session remains active.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the browser Realtime Talk foundation and is the strongest history-backed owner for this cross-UI, Gateway, and provider decision.
